headline: US and Iran reportedly close to an MoU to end the war, Axios reports; crude hit, stocks at highs - Newsquawk US Market Open
summary: Brent crude fell below $101.50 a barrel and European equities rose, after Axios reported the US and Iran were closing in on a memorandum of understanding to end the conflict. The euro traded above 1.1770.
why: Brent is the global crude benchmark, and Middle East conflict directly affects oil supply risk and prices across equity and currency markets.

impacts.name: DAX
impacts.why: The DAX rose sharply as the report reduced geopolitical risk for European equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports of a near-term US-Iran memorandum reduced the perceived risk of supply disruption, pressuring crude and lifting risk assets.
